_source: The four base gene sets are investigator-defined sets motivated by the plasma-cell-dense niche programs reported in the Visium HD / Xenium / scRNA-seq study of Ohlstrom et al. (2026, bioRxiv preprint, doi 10.64898/2026.03.23.713195, Bhasin lab), which reports plasma-cell-dense niches enriched for non-canonical Wnt signalling with gene expression supporting cell adhesion-mediated drug resistance, inferior progression-free survival and extramedullary lesions. That preprint uses the Xenium 5K trephine data of Yip et al. (2025, Blood, doi 10.1182/blood.2025028896) for single-cell validation; Yip et al. themselves do not analyse Wnt signalling, drug resistance or survival, and conclude that no universal bone marrow niche supports myeloma expansion. The exact gene lists are not reproduced from a published supplementary table and should be described as investigator-defined. Lineage markers are the Xenium 5K panel markers used for cell typing in Yip et al. 2025. wnt_core and adhesion_survival are the Wnt-component and non-Wnt subsets of wnt_camdr, scored separately so the morphological signal can be attributed to one or the other.

_labels.wnt_camdr: Investigator-defined set of ten Wnt ligands, receptors and secreted antagonists plus eight niche adhesion, survival and cytokine genes; the Wnt members have opposing effects on pathway output, so the score is not a Wnt pathway activity estimate, and no drug response data exist in this dataset.
_labels.wnt_core: The ten Wnt pathway members of wnt_camdr: ligands (WNT5A, WNT5B, WNT10A), receptors and co-receptors (ROR2, FZD3, LRP6) and secreted antagonists (FRZB, DKK1, SFRP1, SFRP2). Members have opposing effects on pathway output, so the score is a gene-set abundance, not a pathway activity estimate; SFRP1 and SFRP2 are methylation-silenced in most plasma cells and most plausibly report stroma.
_labels.adhesion_survival: The eight non-Wnt members of wnt_camdr: adhesion molecules (NCAM1, CDH2), survival and transcription factors (BCL2, IRF4), growth factors and cytokine receptors (IGF1, VEGFB, MIF, IFNAR2). MIF is the best supported cell adhesion-mediated drug resistance gene in the set (Zheng et al. 2016); NCAM1 and BCL2 carry evidence pointing toward better outcome or drug sensitivity rather than resistance.
_labels.pc_stress_survival: Plasma cell stress and survival genes: two mTOR regulators (DEPTOR, DDIT4), one unfolded protein response kinase (EIF2AK3, which encodes PERK) and three cytokine or innate immune receptors (TNFRSF13B, which encodes TACI, plus TLR10 and IL16); the unfolded protein response and mTOR label describes three of six genes.
_labels.t_exhaustion: Mixed T cell immunoregulation genes: regulatory T cell markers (FOXP3, IL2RA, CTLA4), one inhibitory checkpoint (LAG3), one costimulatory memory marker (CD27) and three general immunoregulatory genes (TNFAIP3, CD55, AHR); only LAG3, and CTLA4 in part, are exhaustion markers, and the prognostic significance of regulatory T cells in myeloma is contested.
_labels.cytotoxicity: Cytotoxic lymphocyte effector genes, used as a control program; fifteen of seventeen members are T cell or natural killer cell effector or lineage genes, while DEFA3 and DEFA4 encode neutrophil alpha-defensins and report granulocyte content.

_drug_resistance_link.wnt_camdr: Gene set associated with drug resistance in the literature, not a measured drug response: ROR2/WNT5A mediates myeloma adhesion to the marrow through PI3K/AKT (Frenquelli et al. 2020, Leukemia, single study); canonical Wnt activity mediates proliferation, migration and drug resistance (van Andel et al. 2019, Leukemia, review); Wnt inhibition reduces the unfolded protein response and enhances bortezomib-induced death (Spaan et al. 2023, Blood Advances); the founding cell adhesion-mediated drug resistance evidence is for doxorubicin and melphalan (Damiano et al. 1999, Blood); canonical Wnt acts through CD44 to increase stromal adhesion and lenalidomide resistance (Bjorklund et al. 2014, Leukemia, single study); MIF drives stromal adhesion and chemoresistance (Zheng et al. 2016, JNCI, single study).
_drug_resistance_link.wnt_core: See wnt_camdr; this subset isolates the Wnt components so their contribution can be measured separately.
_drug_resistance_link.adhesion_survival: See wnt_camdr; this subset isolates the adhesion, survival and cytokine genes that are not Wnt components.
_drug_resistance_link.pc_stress_survival: Plasma cell stress and survival genes (DEPTOR is an mTOR inhibitor overexpressed in myeloma, Peterson et al. 2009, Cell; EIF2AK3 encodes PERK of the unfolded protein response; DDIT4 encodes REDD1; TNFRSF13B encodes TACI); three of six genes relate to the stress axis that proteasome inhibitors act on.
_drug_resistance_link.t_exhaustion: Mixed exhaustion and regulatory T-cell genes; only LAG3 and in part CTLA4 are exhaustion markers. LAG3/TIGIT-dominant suppression was reported in extramedullary myeloma niches (Bingham et al. 2026, Blood Advances).
_drug_resistance_link.cytotoxicity: Cytotoxic effector genes used as a control program; DEFA3 and DEFA4 report granulocyte content.
